# Code Anchors: Filing Preflight

- `libs/delivery-config/src/story-filer/preflight.ts` — the legality decision before configuration resolution: the target-folder-inside-root test.
- `libs/delivery-config/src/story-filer/preflight.spec.ts` — coverage for discovery, the empty folder, the out-of-root rejection and the refusal outcome.
- `libs/delivery-config/src/story-filer/stub-parent.ts` — the parent check: an unplanned item may name only an initiative as its parent, read once per distinct parent, and only when such an item exists.
- `libs/delivery-config/src/story-filer/run.ts` — runs the parent check before anything is created and before a rehearsal previews the batch.
- `libs/delivery-config/src/story-filer/initiative.spec.ts` — coverage for the parent check: a stub under an initiative is filed, any other parent refuses the batch, and a batch naming no parent reads nothing.
- `libs/delivery-config/src/story-filer/labels.ts` — establishes every label the run will apply before the first create, ending the run when one can neither be found nor created.
- `libs/delivery-config/src/issue-kind.ts` — the kind rule the parent check reads a parent's initiative marker through.
